Pool financing 101

Pool loans, home equity, HELOCs and refinancing, in plain English.

5 min readBy the iTop Pools crewUpdated November 2026
Key takeaways
  • The four common routes are a pool loan, home equity loan, HELOC and cash-out refinance.
  • Loans secured by your home usually carry lower rates, but put the home at risk.
  • iTop isn't a lender, so talk to a lender or advisor before you choose.

Most families finance at least part of a pool. These are the four common routes.

1. Unsecured pool loan

A personal loan made for home projects. It's fast, and your house isn't collateral, but rates are usually higher.

2. Home equity loan

A fixed amount borrowed against your equity. It usually carries a lower rate, but your home secures it.

3. HELOC

A line of credit you draw as the build progresses. Rates are often variable.

4. Cash-out refinance

You replace your mortgage with a larger one. This can make sense when current rates are at or below your existing rate.

Try different down payments and terms in our estimator. Talk to a lender or financial advisor before you choose. iTop isn't a lender.
